description: Collection configuration (RULES.md P7): the terms of the coarse-v1 patterns CHAR_ZH and MECH that the glossary lacks. coarse-v2 builds the Chinese character pattern from the glossary Chinese labels and Chinese aliases of character entries plus char_zh, and the mechanic pattern from the canonical names, Chinese labels and unflagged aliases of system and mechanic entries plus mechanic, without the entries of excluded_glossary_entries and the terms of excluded_glossary_terms (reviewed in the coarse-v1 and coarse-v2 comparison of U6.4). A mechanic pattern of kind latin_word matches as a whole word (\b on both sides), case-insensitive; kind cjk matches anywhere.
